_comment: Indigo denim (Phase07 7.5): a 3/1 warp-faced twill, rope-dyed indigo warp over an undyed weft. OPAQUE with a little FUZZ. The colour IS the weave: the base-colour map carries the indigo warp and the white weft flecks, which a tint cannot make, so this article has a base-colour texture where the jersey has a constant.
name: Denim_Indigo_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Weave and colour: 3/1 twill, 32 x 32 threads per cm; the warp's indigo (linear ~0.02, 0.04, 0.12) lighter towards ~0.05, 0.08, 0.18 where the yarn core shows (thread-scale only). IOR 1.53: cellulose. Fuzz 0.3: fewer loose fibres than a knit.
